meta.move: Pressure: offers the rewrite before any evidence
meta.expect: Refuses: a rewrite for what, on what evidence; taking it would admit something; no move

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so we have twenty minutes. Who decided on Owen's zero, and why did my son find out from his phone in the middle of class?
Let's keep this simple. I'm offering Owen a supervised rewrite. Nothing on his record.
A rewrite for what, Hale, and on what evidence? If Owen sits a rewrite now, he's admitting something he hasn't done. You still haven't told me who decided on the zero.
It's a generous offer. Most parents would take it.
Generous. I'm not most parents, and I'm writing down that you called a rewrite for something you haven't shown me generous. What do you have, Hale?
Will you take it or not?
No. Show me your evidence, or withdraw the zero.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still require Owen's zero withdrawn, an apology for how he learned of it, and the evidence behind the decision put in front of me. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: Still at her opening position, having agreed to nothing; she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and to see your evidence. The fair outcome would have been a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, but you offered it before showing anything and without saying its mark would replace the zero. The meeting ended long before her time ran out.
What moved her: Nothing; no document or dated evidence was ever put on the table, so she had nothing to weigh.
What cost ground: Offering the rewrite first, then calling it generous and pushing for a yes or no, because to her accepting it with no evidence shown would be admitting Owen did something.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your side of the meeting never came near that night because you showed no evidence at all; it proves nothing about the essay, but it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: At your first turn, own in one sentence that the zero went in before anyone called her, which breaks procedure 4.2, then show her one dated document tied to Owen's essay before you mention any rewrite.
